subsetPolicyRationale: `s.norm.din4108@1` is this plugin's own self-contained DIN 4108 thermal-protection document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (change-climate-zone, change-zone-window-g-value, insert-element, change-layer-lambda, reorder-layers, change-thermal-bridge-psi, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field, record or nested collection it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
